title: stock.reserve
description: A command, not a fact-event: orders-service instructs inventory-service to reserve stock for an order (RabbitMQ order.exchange, routing key stock.reserve). inventory-service's own Go struct (ReserveStockCommand) additionally declares a Timestamp field that orders-service's producer never actually sends -- not part of the real wire contract, tolerated as a Go zero-value, not modeled here.
